name: Pagination
description: A framework-free Web Component that builds a list of pages, keeps focus where it was after the list is rebuilt, and announces the page change that nothing else would report.

variants.name: Default
variants.description: A list of pages with previous and next, shown at the start, in the middle, and short enough to need no collapsing.

variants.name: Ranges
variants.description: The same page under four different sibling and boundary counts, and the gap that shows a number instead of an ellipsis.

variants.name: Edges
variants.description: Jumps to the first and last page, a numbers-only arrangement, and what happens when an end is reached.

variants.name: Sizes
variants.description: The standard and compact scales beside the unavailable state.

variants.name: Compact
variants.description: A stated position with two arrows, for a column too narrow to hold a row of numbers.

variants.name: Table
variants.description: Pagination driving a plain semantic table, with rows per page and the row range it currently covers.
